channel.title: Kiyan: Intelligence
channel.description: Articles from the Kiyan partners on category management, retail execution and closing the gap between the decision and the shelf.

item.title: Category management wasn't built for easy times. Neither is Saudi retail.
item.description: Category management was born in a squeeze. Saudi retailers, manufacturers and distributors face a similar one today, and the choice is the same: negotiate harder, or grow the category together.

item.title: Why value leaks between the decision and the shelf
item.description: Most companies already hold the data and the plan. The return is lost in the steps between a category decision and what the shopper finds in the store.
